name: Mobile Engineer Chat — Adaptive Interface for Android
description: Adapt Engineer Chat interface for mobile devices (Android/iOS). Make it fully usable from phone browsers and integrate with Termux workflow.
notes: Mobile adaptation of Internal SR interface. Should work seamlessly with mobile_workflow.json.

Commands can be copied with one tap
